indication_area: Prevention of acute and delayed chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting (HEC and MEC regimens)
geography: Worldwide (the issuer's total net product sales line for the product; launched in the U.S.)

approval_evidence.quote: application_number NDA209296, brand_name CINVANTI, sponsor HERON THERAPS INC, submission_type ORIG, submission_status AP, submission_status_date 20171109 (openFDA Drugs@FDA record)

launch_evidence.quote: CINVANTI was approved by the FDA on November 9, 2017 and became commercially available in the U.S. on January 4, 2018. (Heron Q3 2018 release, Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1 filed 2018-11-07)

series_start_reason: CINVANTI became commercially available on January 4, 2018; the series starts at the launch quarter.
search_log: Listed every Heron (CIK 818033) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions; scanned every 8-K with item 2.02 and every 10-Q/10-K filed 2016-07-01 to 2026-11-04 for 'sustol|cinvanti|zynrelef' in table rows and text (bin/scan.py), and extracted the per-product net product sales sentences from every release (bin/prose.py).

Heron printed per-product net product sales only in release sentences (rounded to $0.1 million) until Q1 2022; 10-Qs print a per-product table (in thousands) from Q2 2022; Q4 releases print per-product sentences for 2022-2023 and a per-product net revenue table from Q4 2024. Each quarter is taken from the filing that reports it as current: 10-Q three-months column for Q1-Q3 from Q2 2022, otherwise the quarter's release.
CINVANTI: 2018Q1-2022Q1 and Q4 2022-2023 from release sentences; Q2 2022-Q2 2026 Q1-Q3 from 10-Qs; Q4 2024-2025 from the Q4 release product tables.
